solution_steps: Summon Pyramid Turtle in attack mode.
Run Giant Germ into White Magical Hat and summon another two.
Run Pyramid Turtle into Shining Angel consecutively and summon another Pyramid turtle. If there is none left, summon Shadow Ghoul.
Activate Offerings to the Doomed from your hand to destroy Shining Angel.
